title: ieee80211: update neighbor report to last standard
description:
The following changes were made:
- add DMG Positioning bit from 802.11-2024
- convert Immediate/Delayed BA bits to reserved as per 802.11-2024
- homogenize PHY bits' names
- add string to value for operating class
- remove custom function for channel [the custom function used is specific to beacon reports]
- create and add string to value for PHY type
